abilities.name: Raise Skeleton
abilities.description: When a nearby enemy Minion dies, it becomes a Skeletal Warrior with 240 Health that attacks for 21 damage and lasts up to 12 seconds. Upon death, Skeletal Warriors deal 40 damage to nearby enemies. Up to 3 Skeletal Warriors can be active at once when spawned in this way. Skeletal Warrior Corpse Explosion ; Trait

fields.notes: This explosion damage will not trigger A Call For Help, i.e. Structure aggro onto Xul, if Xul and an enemy Hero hit by the explosion are in range of that enemy's Fort, Keep or Core.

abilities.name: Spectral Scythe
abilities.description: Summon a scythe that travels to Xul after 1 second, dealing 190 damage to enemies and spawning a Skeletal Warrior when hitting Enemy Heroes. These do not count toward Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.

fields.notes: The scythe persists up to 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Cursed Strikes
abilities.description: Xul's Basic Attack deals damage in a wide area and reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes and Summons by 40% for 2 seconds. Lasts 4 seconds once triggered.

fields.affects: Enemies (damage) / Enemy Heroes and Summons (Attack Slow)
fields.props: Area of Effect, Attack Modifier, Attack Slow, Cleave, Primed
fields.notes: Cooldown and duration start once the ability is triggered by attacking an enemy. Partial Basic Attack reset if timed correctly (sets Basic Attack timer to 0.25s).

abilities.name: Bone Prison
abilities.description: After a 2 second delay, deal 80 damage and root the target enemy Hero for 1.75 seconds. All nearby Skeletal Warriors will fixate on the target for their duration.

fields.notes: The target becomes Revealed once the ability is cast until the Root wears off.

abilities.name: Poison Nova
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.; 90; 100; Heroic

abilities.name: Skeletal Mages
abilities.description: Summon 4 Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for 47 damage a second and Slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Lasts up to 15 seconds. Frost Mage ; 90; 80; Heroic

fields.notes: First point determines the center point and second the direction of the line of summoned units.

abilities.name: Bone Armor
abilities.description: Activate to gain a Shield equal to 25% of Xul's maximum Health for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Backlash
talents.description: When Bone Armor expires, nearby enemy Heroes take damage equal to 12% of their maximum Health.
_raw_fields: When Bone Armor expires, nearby enemy Heroes take damage equal to 12% of their maximum Health.

talents.name: Shackler
talents.description: While Bone Armor is active, nearby enemies are Slowed by 35% for 1 Second. Basic Attacks against Heroes that are Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor by 2 seconds.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Attack Modifier (cdr), Slow
fields.notes: Cleaving Basic Attacks from Cursed Strikes can also apply the cooldown reduction.

_raw_fields: While Bone Armor is active, nearby enemies are Slowed by 35% for 1 Second. Basic Attacks against Heroes that are Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor by 2 seconds.

talents.name: Shade
talents.description: While Bone Armor is active, Xul evades all Basic Attacks, but increases the cooldown of Bone Armor by 10 seconds.
_raw_fields: While Bone Armor is active, Xul evades all Basic Attacks, but increases the cooldown of Bone Armor by 10 seconds.

talents.name: Reaper's Toll
talents.description: Reduce the cooldown of Spectral Scythe by 2 seconds and its Mana cost by 15.
_raw_fields: Reduce the cooldown of Spectral Scythe by 2 seconds and its Mana cost by 15.

talents.name: Grim Scythe
talents.description: Increase Xul's Basic Attack damage by 15%. Each enemy hit by Cursed Strikes reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 12 seconds.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Xul's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Increase Xul's Basic Attack damage by 15%. Each enemy hit by Cursed Strikes reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 12 seconds.

talents.name: Jailors
talents.description: Bone Prison spawns 2 Skeletal Warriors. These do not count toward Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum. Quest Spawn 80 Skeletal Warriors. While fixating on an enemy, Skeletal Warriors gain 25% Movement and Attack Speed.
_raw_fields: Bone Prison spawns 2 Skeletal Warriors. These do not count toward Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum. Quest Spawn 80 Skeletal Warriors. While fixating on an enemy, Skeletal Warriors gain 25% Movement and Attack Speed.

talents.name: Harvest Vitality
talents.description: Cursed Strikes heals for 70% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
_raw_fields: Cursed Strikes heals for 70% of the damage dealt to Heroes.

talents.name: Trag'Oul's Essence
talents.description: Every time a Skeletal Warrior attacks an enemy, restore 0.2% of Xul's maximum Health and 0.5% of his maximum Mana.
_raw_fields: Every time a Skeletal Warrior attacks an enemy, restore 0.2% of Xul's maximum Health and 0.5% of his maximum Mana.

talents.name: Wall Of Bones
talents.description: Increase the Shield amount of Bone Armor to 35% of Xul's maximum Health, and Xul gains 20 Spell Armor for its duration.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Increase the Shield amount of Bone Armor to 35% of Xul's maximum Health, and Xul gains 20 Spell Armor for its duration.

talents.name: Poison Nova
talents.description: cooldown 90 After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.
_raw_fields: cooldown 90 After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.

talents.name: Skeletal Mages
talents.description: cooldown 70 Summon 4 Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for 47 damage a second and Slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Lasts up to 15 seconds.
_raw_fields: cooldown 70 Summon 4 Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for 47 damage a second and Slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Lasts up to 15 seconds.

talents.name: Echoes of Death
talents.description: Spectral Scythe spawns 2 additional scythes next to the first after 1.5 seconds, dealing 40% damage.

fields.notes: Scythes are spawned on the same y-coordinates as the initial scythe, which makes their range slightly longer. Damage penalty stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Spectral Scythe 's damage.

_raw_fields: Spectral Scythe spawns 2 additional scythes next to the first after 1.5 seconds, dealing 40% damage.

talents.name: Rapid Harvest
talents.description: Gain 5% Attack Speed for 3 seconds each time Cursed Strikes hits an enemy, up to 75%.
_raw_fields: Gain 5% Attack Speed for 3 seconds each time Cursed Strikes hits an enemy, up to 75%.

talents.name: Amplify Damage
talents.description: Increase the Root duration of Bone Prison by 0.25 seconds. Enemies Rooted by Bone Prison lose 25 Armor for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Increase the Root duration of Bone Prison by 0.25 seconds. Enemies Rooted by Bone Prison lose 25 Armor for 2 seconds.

talents.name: Decrepify
talents.description: Enemy Heroes who are damaged by Spectral Scythe or Skeletal Warriors are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Enemy Heroes who are damaged by Spectral Scythe or Skeletal Warriors are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

talents.name: Weaken
talents.description: Enemy Heroes who are damaged by Cursed Strikes or Skeletal Warriors deal 35% less damage for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that affect the target Hero's damage output.

_raw_fields: Enemy Heroes who are damaged by Cursed Strikes or Skeletal Warriors deal 35% less damage for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Bone Spear
talents.description: cooldown 12 Deal 230 damage to enemies in a line.
_raw_fields: cooldown 12 Deal 230 damage to enemies in a line.

talents.name: Andariel's Visage
talents.description: Poison Nova heals for 50% of the damage dealt and its duration is increased by 50%.
_raw_fields: Poison Nova heals for 50% of the damage dealt and its duration is increased by 50%.

talents.name: Cold Hand of Death
talents.description: Increase the Slow of Frost Mages by 20%. Every 5th Spectral Scythe that hits enemy Heroes spawns a Frost Mage instead of a Skeletal Warrior in their location.
_raw_fields: Increase the Slow of Frost Mages by 20%. Every 5th Spectral Scythe that hits enemy Heroes spawns a Frost Mage instead of a Skeletal Warrior in their location.

talents.name: Mortal Wound
talents.description: Enemies hit by Spectral Scythe receive 75% less healing for 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with modifiers that affect healing received and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing dealt.

_raw_fields: Enemies hit by Spectral Scythe receive 75% less healing for 4 seconds.

talents.name: Kalan's Edict
talents.description: Each time Skeletal Warriors deal damage reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor and Xul's Heroic Ability by 1.5%.
_raw_fields: Each time Skeletal Warriors deal damage reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor and Xul's Heroic Ability by 1.5%.
